author: GitHub Copilot
description: Query a configurable AzerothCore REST bridge for server info, online players, and account creation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration such as API endpoint settings and allowed role IDs. It does not persist user-provided account data.
install_msg: Configure the bridge with `[p]ac set baseurl`, then set your auth token and account creation roles with `[p]ac set token` and `[p]ac set accountcreationrole`. Use `[p]ac set realmlist` for the public WoW connection line, and `[p]ac set createbody` / `[p]ac set createmethod` to match your account creation endpoint. Public users can use `[p]ac info` and `[p]ac online`; approved roles can use `[p]ac createuser`.
name: AzerothCore
short: Interact with an AzerothCore server through a REST bridge
